findings.label: Stale "refines confidence" comment
findings.detail: The mapOne block comment and deriveConfidence JSDoc in HttpUrbaniAlertsAdapter claim alertService nudges/refines confidence after correlation, but no such code exists (grep of 'confidence' in alertService.ts returns nothing; the plan explicitly rejected an evidence-count nudge). The ui.tsx tooltip ('Derived from severity and matched log evidence') inherits the same overstatement. Trim the comments/tooltip to severity-only derivation.

findings.label: Doubled upstream log calls on the alerts path
findings.detail: correlateLiveAlerts re-fetches cloudwatch.getLogs per distinct service on every alert list/get/acknowledge, in addition to the Logs page's own fetches. Acceptable given the adapter's TTL cache, but worth noting.

findings.label: CRITICAL confidence renders green
findings.detail: Derived CRITICAL = 0.9 -> 90% -> success/green in Confidence, which can read oddly next to a CRITICAL severity badge. Cosmetic; confidence color is independent of severity by design.

findings.label: Logs degraded note wording vs empty cache
findings.detail: The degraded note says 'showing the last available window,' but the branch only fires when items.length === 0, so there is no window to show. Consider 'no recent window available.' Copy nit.
